findings.body: Raise: Functional. This treats a saved review or local PR-body file as proof that a pull request exists. If a first close saves its review but GitHub rejects PR creation, a later `forge work` question or `--note` answer calls `_refresh_record`, which queries GitHub and fails during the same outage. The specified pre-PR question path should remain local. The offline-before-PR test starts without a saved review, so it misses this case.
findings.title: A failed first PR publish makes a pre-PR worker question depend on GitHub

findings.body: Raise: Test. The new `forge read` path writes measured seconds to the read note, but the named board tests insert `seconds` into that note directly or construct the note themselves. They would still pass if `forge read` stopped recording the duration, leaving real plan reads unknown in story runways. The timed read needs command-level proof through `forge read`.
findings.title: Not done: forge read records a timed cold-read round

findings.body: Raise: Gate. Both `.claude/skills/forge/SKILL.md` and `.codex/skills/forge/SKILL.md` change instructions for runner diagnosis, upgrade cleanup, read responses and part-size limits. Those changes do not support this part's shared time record or its required shipped guide paragraph, so these outside-Scope files contain work this part does not need.
findings.title: Unrelated live skill changes exceed this part's scope
